details.question: What is the total net revenue broken down by sales channel?
details.agent_sql:
WITH order_rev AS (
  SELECT channel,
         SUM(gross_amount - discount_amount) AS revenue
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY channel
),
return_rev AS (
  SELECT o.channel,
         SUM(r.return_quantity * o.unit_price) AS returns
  FROM returns r
  JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.channel
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(o.channel, r.channel) AS sales_channel,
  COALESCE(o.revenue, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns, 0) AS net_revenue
FROM order_rev o
FULL OUTER JOIN return_rev r
  ON o.channel = r.channel
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC;

details.question: Who are the top 3 brands by net revenue?

WITH brand_revenue AS (
    SELECT p.brand,
           SUM(o.order_amount) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.brand
),
brand_returns AS (
    SELECT p.brand,
           SUM(r.return_amount) AS returns
    FROM returns r
    JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.brand
)
SELECT br.brand,
       (br.revenue - COALESCE(rt.returns, 0)) AS net_revenue
FROM brand_revenue br

ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 3;

details.question: Show me monthly net revenue for 2024.

WITH order_rev AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month,
           SUM(total_amount) AS revenue
    FROM orders
    WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM order_date) = 2024
    GROUP BY 1
),
return_rev AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', return_date) AS month,
           SUM(return_amount) AS returns
    FROM returns
    WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM return_date) = 2024
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT o.month,
       o.revenue - COALESCE(r.returns, 0) AS net_revenue
FROM order_rev o
LEFT JOIN return_rev r ON o.month = r.month
ORDER BY o.month;

details.question: What is the top-selling SKU by net revenue in each product category?
details.agent_sql: SELECT p.category, p.sku, p.name AS sku_name, SUM(o.net_amount) AS net_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN products AS p ON o.sku = p.sku GROUP BY p.category, p.sku, p.name QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(o.net_amount) DESC) = 1 LIMIT 100
details.gold_sql: WITH sku_rev AS (SELECT p.category, o.sku, p.name, ROUND(SUM(o.net_amount), 2) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(o.net_amount) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.sku = p.sku GROUP BY p.category, o.sku, p.name) SELECT category, sku, name, revenue FROM sku_rev WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC;

details.question: What is the return rate percentage for each sales channel?
details.agent_sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS return_rate_percentage FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN returns AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY o.channel LIMIT 100
details.gold_sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM orders o LEFT JOIN returns r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC;

details.question: Show the cumulative running monthly net revenue for 2023.
details.agent_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date) AS month, SUM(net_amount) AS monthly_net, SUM(SUM(net_amount)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date)) AS cumulative_net FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2023 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 100
details.gold_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(net_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE strftime(order_date, '%Y') = '2023' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS monthly_revenue, ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_revenue FROM monthly ORDER BY month;

details.question: How many high-value customers have spent more than 15,000 INR in total?
details.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_value_customer_count FROM (SELECT customer_id, SUM(net_amount) AS total_spend FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(net_amount) > 15000) AS high_spenders LIMIT 100
details.gold_sql: WITH customer_spend AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(net_amount) AS total_spend FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_value_customer_count FROM customer_spend WHERE total_spend > 15000;

details.question: Which brand has the highest return rate percentage?
details.agent_sql: SELECT p.brand, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT r.return_id IS NULL THEN o.order_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM orders AS o JOIN products AS p ON o.sku = p.sku LEFT JOIN returns AS r ON r.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 1
details.gold_sql: SELECT p.brand, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS brand_return_rate FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.sku = p.sku LEFT JOIN returns r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY brand_return_rate DESC LIMIT 1;

details.question: What is the average review rating of our top 5 most returned products?
details.agent_sql: WITH top_returns AS (SELECT o.sku, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM returns AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.sku ORDER BY return_cnt DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT p.sku, p.name, tr.return_cnt, AVG(rv.rating) AS avg_rating FROM top_returns AS tr JOIN products AS p ON tr.sku = p.sku LEFT JOIN reviews AS rv ON rv.sku = tr.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.name, tr.return_cnt ORDER BY tr.return_cnt DESC LIMIT 100
details.gold_sql: WITH top_returned AS (SELECT o.sku, COUNT(r.return_id) AS ret_cnt FROM orders o JOIN returns r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY o.sku ORDER BY ret_cnt DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT tr.sku, p.name, tr.ret_cnt, ROUND(AVG(rev.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM top_returned tr JOIN products p ON tr.sku = p.sku LEFT JOIN reviews rev ON tr.sku = rev.sku GROUP BY tr.sku, p.name, tr.ret_cnt ORDER BY tr.ret_cnt DESC;

details.question: List our top 5 most frequent customers with their order count and total spend.
details.agent_sql: SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.net_amount) AS total_spend FROM orders AS o GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY order_count DESC, total_spend DESC LIMIT 5
details.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders, ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) AS total_spend FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_orders DESC, total_spend DESC LIMIT 5;

details.question: What was the quarterly Average Order Value by channel in 2024?
details.agent_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', order_date) AS quarter, channel, ROUND(SUM(net_amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS aov FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2024 GROUP BY quarter, channel ORDER BY quarter, channel LIMIT 100
details.gold_sql: SELECT channel, strftime(order_date, '%Y-Q') || ((CAST(strftime(order_date, '%m') AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1) AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(net_amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS aov FROM orders WHERE strftime(order_date, '%Y') = '2024' GROUP BY channel, quarter ORDER BY channel, quarter;

details.question: Calculate the month-over-month revenue growth rate for 2024.
details.agent_sql: WITH monthly_rev AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date) AS month, SUM(net_amount) AS net_rev FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2024 GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, net_rev, ROUND((net_rev - LAG(net_rev) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(net_rev) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM monthly_rev ORDER BY month LIMIT 100
details.gold_sql: WITH m_rev AS (SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(net_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE strftime(order_date, '%Y') = '2024' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue, ROUND((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM m_rev ORDER BY month;

How many orders were shipped to customers in London and Paris?
